frame.title: Frame & chrome
frame.statusFrameHint: The coloured plate (green, red, amber, grey) drawn on every enigma image to show its result. Shrink it when your frame artwork isn't perfectly rectangular and the plate sticks out. The tint over the image keeps the colour readable even on artwork with an opaque background. Leave blank to keep the built-in look; check it with the preview's “Result” selector.

gauge.title: Levels gauge
gauge.fillGeometryHint: Adjusts where the coloured fill sits inside your gauge artwork. Insets are % of the gauge, radius is in pixels. Leave blank to keep the automatic alignment. The level icons and the player icon follow the same values.
gauge.fillGeometryLayoutHint: You can also drag them on the real gauge: the “In-game layout” button at the top, “Gauge” tab.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.scoreFullGame: Score needed to fill the gauge
scoring.malusBothAnswers: malus if both answers are biped

enigmas.title: Enigmas
enigmas.goShortCode: GO short code (printed on the enigma)
enigmas.wrongAnswerPointsHint: Negative = penalty (e.g. -5). Same as the maluses.
enigmas.overCapWarning: This scenario has {{total}} enigmas, over the maximum of {{max}}. Delete {{count}} to get back within the limit.

goOption.description: Hardware-free, phone-browser version of this Mystery. Players type a short code on each enigma and tap a letter - no RFID. Greyed sections below aren’t used in GO.
goOption.hint: 4 options is GO-only and adds two extra wrong-answer images per enigma. Each enigma needs a short code; the correct letter per enigma comes from the GO pattern (modèle).

spotOption.description: Hardware-free, on-screen version of this Mystery. Answer images appear on the device instead of being scanned via RFID stations - no chips needed. Enabling this keeps the scenario usable with RFID and GO too.

pattern.title: Default pattern
pattern.defaultMysteryPattern: Default Mystery pattern (enigma answer images → station mapping)
pattern.rfidHint: Assigns each enigma's good/wrong answer images to stations/balises (RFID Playground). The mapping is shown next to each image below. Overridable at launch.
pattern.defaultGoPattern: Default GO pattern (letter answer key for Tag Hunter GO)
pattern.goHint: Every client granted this scenario in GO uses this pattern. “Create random” builds one with a randomised correct letter per enigma; edit it later from the Patterns page.
pattern.generateHint: Generates {{answers}} answers with the correct letter randomised per enigma, and selects it as this scenario’s default GO pattern.

goSpot.title: Tag Hunter GO & Spot
goSpot.answerHint: Shared by GO and Spot: in GO these are the letters offered (A/B or A/B/C/D), in Spot the number of on-screen tiles. Picking 4 adds two extra wrong-answer images per enigma.
